landing.metaTitle: Jumps Lab: the training log for jumpers
landing.metaDescription: A free training log for high jump, long jump, triple jump and pole vault. Log every attempt, keep wind-legal bests, and get ready for the next meet.
landing.title: Built for every jump.
landing.lead: High jump, long jump, triple jump and pole vault. Log every attempt, keep wind-legal bests, and get ready for the next meet.
landing.logTitle: Every jump, one at a time.
landing.logBody: Log each attempt with its mark and wind, as practice or competition. Add how the day felt: condition, fatigue and sleep.
landing.bestsBody: Personal and season bests come from competition marks. A tailwind over +2.0 m/s is marked wind-aided and left out. Practice keeps its own best.
landing.meetsBody: Keep the venue, call room, start time and entry site with each meet. Count down the days, then see the result from that day's marks.
landing.analysisBody: Jumps, average, monthly bests and your last 10, for each event.
landing.sampleDayNote: Approach felt fast. Work on the last two steps.
landing.photoLongJump: A long jumper in the air above the sand pit
landing.photoHighJump: A high jumper clearing the bar in front of a crowd
landing.photoFlight: A long jumper in flight, legs thrown forward

advice.title: Today's advice

reason.injury: You noted pain or discomfort. Skip jumps, sprints and loading that use that area.
reason.preMeet: {days, plural, =0 {Meet today.} one {Meet tomorrow.} other {Meet in # days.}} Cut volume; keep speed and jump quality.
reason.taper: {days} days to your main goal meet. Reduce volume step by step; keep intensity and how often you train.
reason.shortWeek: Your sleep over the last week averaged {average} hours, below {target} hours.

advice.doctor: See a doctor or physio if it hurts at rest or at night, is swollen, hurts when you press one spot on a bone, makes you limp, is not gone by the next morning, or keeps coming back for weeks.
advice.toward: {weeks, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}} to your main goal meet

aiConsent.title: Before you use the AI coach
aiConsent.changed: What the AI coach sends has changed, so please read it again. New: your personal best and season best for each event.
aiConsent.askAgeNow: We now ask your age before you use the AI coach. Please answer the question below.
aiConsent.intro: To make and revise your menu, the AI coach sends the following to OpenAI, a company in the United States.
aiConsent.sentProfile: Age, gender, height, weight and events
aiConsent.sentBests: Personal best and season best for each event
aiConsent.sentCondition: Condition, fatigue, sleep, pain notes and practice notes from the last 14 days
aiConsent.sentAttempts: Attempts from the last 14 days: event, practice or competition, mark, wind and note
aiConsent.sentCompetitions: How many days are left to competitions in the next 8 weeks, and which one is the main goal
aiConsent.sentSession: Today's intensity and its reasons, the practice time and note entered, and in the chat the current menu and the messages
aiConsent.sentMeet: On a competition day, that meet's venue, call room place and time, start time and notes
aiConsent.notSent: Your name and email address are not sent.
aiConsent.system: Its privacy rules: there is no single federal privacy law; sector-specific federal laws and state laws apply. <link>Summary by Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission (as of October 2021)</link>
aiConsent.measures: OpenAI's measures: data sent to its API is not used to train its models unless the account opts in, and abuse monitoring logs are kept for up to 30 days unless the law requires longer. Jumps Lab asks OpenAI not to store the replies for later retrieval. <link>OpenAI: Data controls</link>
aiConsent.medical: The AI coach does not diagnose or judge injuries or illness. If something hurts, see a doctor.
aiConsent.guardianNeeded: You're under 16, so a parent or guardian needs to agree. We'll email them this information and a link to agree.
aiConsent.sent: We sent a request to {email}. The link works for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
aiConsent.expired: The request sent to {email} has expired.

guardianConsent.title: Consent for the AI coach
guardianConsent.intro: {name} would like to use the AI coach in Jumps Lab, an app for logging jumps. Because {name} is under 16, we ask a parent or guardian to agree.
guardianConsent.sentIntro: To make and revise practice menus, the AI coach sends the following about {name} to OpenAI, a company in the United States.
guardianConsent.notSent: {name}'s name and email address are not sent.
guardianConsent.done: Thank you. {name} can now use the AI coach.
guardianConsent.invalid: This link is no longer valid.
guardianConsent.invalidNext: If you still want to agree, ask them to send a new request from the app.

guardianMail.subject: A request for your consent to use the AI coach in Jumps Lab
guardianMail.body:
{name} would like to use the AI coach in Jumps Lab, an app for logging jumps. Because {name} is under 16, we need a parent or guardian to agree.

To make practice menus, the AI coach sends {name}'s age, gender, height, weight, condition, sleep, pain notes and practice and competition records to OpenAI, a company in the United States. {name}'s name and email address are not sent.

Read the details and agree here. The link works for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
{url}

If you don't know {name} or don't want to agree, you can ignore this email.

Jumps Lab (kk-web)
guardianMail.teamSubject: A request for your consent to join a team in Jumps Lab
guardianMail.teamBody:
{name} would like to join the team {team}, coached by {coach}, in Jumps Lab, an app for logging jumps. Because {name} is under 16, we need a parent or guardian to agree.

If {name} joins, the team's coaches can see {name}'s attempts, condition, sleep, pain notes, practice notes, competitions and videos. They can only look, and {name} can leave the team anytime. {name}'s email address is not shown.

Read the details and agree here. The link works for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
{url}

If you don't know {name} or don't want to agree, you can ignore this email.

Jumps Lab (kk-web)
